ingredients.name: chicken stock, or veal or beef stock

steps.instruction: Skim all the fat off 1 quart of stock.
Taste the stock and add salt if it needs it.
steps.spoken: Taste the stock and add salt if it needs it. If you will serve the consommé cold, add a little extra salt, because a cold dish needs more.

steps.instruction: Beat 1 cup of the stock with 2 egg whites in a large bowl.
Bring the rest of the stock to a simmer in a saucepan.
Pour the hot stock into the egg whites in a thin stream, beating all the time.
Pour the stock back into the saucepan.
Heat over medium heat, stirring with a wire whisk, until it simmers.
Stop stirring as soon as the stock simmers.
Move the pot to the edge of the burner and heat on low for 5 minutes.
Turn the pot a quarter turn and heat for 5 minutes.
Turn the pot a quarter turn again and heat for 5 minutes.
Turn the pot a quarter turn once more and heat for 5 minutes.
Line a colander with damp cheesecloth and set it over a bowl.
Carefully ladle the stock and egg whites into the colander.
steps.spoken: Carefully ladle the stock and egg whites into the colander. Try to disturb the egg whites as little as possible.
Let it drain for 5 to 6 minutes.

steps.instruction: Stir 1/3 cup of Madeira, port or cognac into the consommé.
